for (const c of [P?.casterTokenUuid, P?.sourceTokenUuid, P?.tokenUuid]) { const t = tokFromUuid(c); if (t) return t; }

const doneHook = 'oni.anim.' + ANIM_KEY + '.' + (foundry?.utils?.randomID?.(8) ?? String(Date.now()));

const readyHook = doneHook + '.ready';

return new Promise((resolve) => {

const h = (d) => { if (settled) return; settled = true; clearTimeout(timer); Hooks.off(hookName, h); resolve(d ?? { ok: true }); };

const scriptSource = String.raw`

const cfg = ctx.params.cfg || {};

const A = ctx.params.assets || {};

const caster = ctx.casterToken;

const tgts = (ctx.targetTokens || []).filter(t => t && t.center);

const prime = tgts[0] || null;

Redrawn every frame because the caster is physically moving. const tether = new PIXI.Graphics(); layer.addChild(tether); // A chevron over the victim plus their name, so the target is unambiguous. const marker = new PIXI.Container(); const chev = new PIXI.Graphics(); chev.beginFill(GLOW, 0.95); chev.moveTo(-16, -14); chev.lineTo(16, -14); chev.lineTo(0, 8); chev.closePath(); chev.endFill(); marker.addChild(chev); const label = new PIXI.Text(String(victim.document.name || ''), { fontFamily: 'Signika, sans-serif', fontSize: 22, fill: 0xe8dcff, stroke: 0x150a22, strokeThickness: 5, }); label.anchor.set(0.5, 1); label.position.set(0, -20); marker.addChild(label); layer.addChild(marker); const t0 = performance.now(); const total = (cfg.fadeInMs || 400) + (cfg.slideMs || 2400) + (cfg.fadeOutMs || 600); let done = false; const tick = () => { const e = performance.now() - t0; // envelope let a = 1; if (e < cfg.fadeInMs) a = e / cfg.fadeInMs; else if (e > total - cfg.fadeOutMs) a = Math.max(0, (total - e) / cfg.fadeOutMs); layer.alpha = a; const c = caster.center, v = victim.center; // tether: a dark cord with a travelling highlight tether.clear(); tether.lineStyle(6, DARK, 0.55 * a); tether.moveTo(c.x, c.y); tether.lineTo(v.x, v.y); const id = Hooks.once(h, () => { if (!fired) { fired = true; res(true); } });

});

// to exactly the one carrying "Marked").

const casterUuid = payload.casterTokenUuid

|| (canvas.tokens.controlled[0] && canvas.tokens.controlled[0].document.uuid);

const casterTok = canvas.tokens.placeables.find((t) => t.document.uuid === casterUuid);

const victimTok = Array.from(game.user.targets)[0]

|| canvas.tokens.placeables.find((t) => (payload.targetTokenUuids || []).includes(t.document.uuid));

if (!casterTok || !victimTok) return;

// How far along the walk are we? The Approach AE has already ticked by the

// time this runs, so charges is 1, 2 or 3.

let charges = 1;

try {

const ae = casterTok.actor.effects.find((e) => !e.disabled && String(e.name).toLowerCase() === "approach");

// re-converges next turn; no stored home position to go stale.

const ny = c.y + (dy / dist) * travel - (casterTok.h / 2);

{ x: Math.round(nx), y: Math.round(ny) },

{ animation: { duration: CFG.slideMs, easing: "easeInOutCosine" } }

);

// a payload without one and the emit is dropped with only a console warn,

// so the token would still slide but the tether would never draw. It is

// just a dedupe/logging label here; the listener runs scriptSource.

const vfx = game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: "roo-approach",

scriptSource: INNER,

casterTokenUuid: casterTok.document.uuid,

targetTokenUuids: [victimTok.document.uuid],

params: { doneHook, cfg: CFG },

});

await Promise.all([move, vfx, onceHook(doneHook, CFG.failsafeMs)]);

} catch (e) {

console.error("Roo Approach animation:", e);

} finally {

Hooks.callAll("oni:animationEnd", { skill: "Approach" }, { local: true, world: false });

}

})();

• Trigger the start of the Roo's turn

blade.rotation = -Math.atan2(-49, -45);

knife.addChild(blade);

const reach = Math.hypot(blade.width, blade.height) * 0.86;

// The glint: a small four-point star.

const glint = new PIXI.Graphics();

glint.beginFill(0xffffff, 1);

for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {

const a = i * Math.PI / 2, c = Math.cos(a), s = Math.sin(a);

glint.drawPolygon([c * 1.5, s * 1.5, -s * 0.09, c * 0.09, s * 0.09, -c * 0.09]);

}

glint.endFill();

const halo = new PIXI.Sprite(oni.radialTexture('rgba(255,255,255,1)', 'rgba(255,255,255,0)', { size: 64 }));

halo.anchor.set(0.5);

halo.width = halo.height = 1.6;

glint.addChild(halo);

glint.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD;

halo.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD;

glint.zIndex = 30;

glint.alpha = 0;

host.addChild(glint);

const camming = oni.camera.focus({ point: { x: (home.x + t.x) / 2, y: t.y - 20 }, zoom: cfg.camZoom, duration: cfg.camInMs });

const dimming = oni.sceneDim({ to: cfg.dimTo, fadeIn: cfg.dimInMs, color: cfg.dimColor });

let stepped = false, glinted = false, stabbed = false, darked = false, recovering = null;

let targetFlash = null;

function frame(now) {

if (!stepped && now >= cfg.stepAt) { stepped = true; playSfx('sfxStep', 'sfxStepVol'); }

if (!glinted && now >= cfg.glintAt) { glinted = true; playSfx('sfxGlint', 'sfxGlintVol'); }

if (!stabbed && now >= stab) {

stabbed = true;

playSfx('sfxStab', 'sfxStabVol');

oni.domFlash({ color: '#fff', fadeIn: 16, hold: 0, fadeOut: cfg.flashOutMs, alpha: cfg.flashAlpha });

oni.screenshake({ duration: cfg.shakeMs, intensity: cfg.shakeAmp });

oni.vfx(A.spark, { x: tip.x, y: tip.y, size: cfg.sparkSize, blend: PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD, parent: host, zIndex: 40 });

targetFlash = oni.cloneToken(prime, { parent: host });

if (targetFlash) { targetFlash.zIndex = 5; targetFlash.blendMode = PIXI.BLEND_MODES.ADD; }

done();

}

if (!darked && now >= stab + 60) { darked = true; playSfx('sfxDark', 'sfxDarkVol'); }

if (!recovering && now >= back) {

recovering = Promise.all([

oni.camera.restore({ duration: cfg.camOutMs }),

wait(100).then(() => dimming).then((d) => d && d.fadeOut({ duration: cfg.dimOutMs })),

]);

}

const hit = now >= stab, frozen = hit && now < stab + cfg.freezeMs;

const draw = io(seg(now, cfg.drawAt, cfg.glintAt));

const out = io(seg(now, stab + cfg.freezeMs, back + 500));

const step = io(seg(now, cfg.stepAt, cfg.stepAt + cfg.stepMs)) * cfg.stepPx * (1 - io(seg(now, back, back + cfg.camOutMs)));

const lean = hit ? 0 : draw * cfg.leanPx;

const cx = home.x + dirX * (step + (hit ? lerp(lunge, 0, out) : 0) - lean);

clone.position.set(cx, home.y);

clone.scale.x = baseX * (frozen ? 1.12 : hit ? 1 : lerp(1, 0.97, draw));

clone.scale.y = baseY * (frozen ? 0.94 : hit ? 1 : lerp(1, 1.03, draw));

const cockX = cx - dirX * 30, cockY = home.y + 6;

let px, py;

if (!hit) {

px = lerp(cx + dirX * 8, cockX, draw);

py = lerp(home.y + 14, cockY, draw);

} else {

px = lerp(tip.x - Math.cos(aim) * reach, cockX, out);

py = lerp(tip.y - Math.sin(aim) * reach, cockY, out);

}

knife.position.set(px, py);

knife.alpha = seg(now, cfg.drawAt - 100, cfg.drawAt - 100 + cfg.knifeInMs) * (1 - seg(now, back + 500, back + 1000));

const g = !hit && now >= cfg.glintAt ? Math.sin(seg(now, cfg.glintAt, cfg.glintAt + cfg.glintMs) * Math.PI) : 0;

glint.alpha = g;

glint.scale.set(Math.max(0.001, cfg.glintSize * g));

glint.position.set(px + Math.cos(aim) * reach, py + Math.sin(aim) * reach);

if (targetFlash && !targetFlash.destroyed) targetFlash.alpha = cfg.targetFlash * (1 - seg(now, stab, stab + cfg.targetFlashMs));

}

await oni.tween({ from: 0, to: total, duration: total, ease: E.linear, onUpdate: frame });

await Promise.all([camming, recovering]);

restoreCaster();

`;

try {

emitLocal('oni:animationStart', { type: ANIM_KEY, sceneId: canvas.scene?.id ?? null, sourceTokenId: sourceToken?.id ?? null });

const waitDone = onceHook(doneHook, CFG.totalTimeoutMs || 20000);

await game.ONI.pseudo.play({

scriptId: ANIM_KEY,

scriptSource,

casterTokenUuid: sourceToken?.document?.uuid ?? null,

targetTokenUuids: partyTargets.map(t => t.document.uuid),

params: { doneHook, readyHook, cfg: CFG, assets: ASSETS },

meta: { source: "Chef's Knife" },

});

// (animationStart emitted above)

const result = await waitDone;

if (!result?.ok) console.warn(TAG, 'pseudo non-OK / timeout', result);

} catch (err) {

console.error(TAG, 'orchestration crashed', err);

} finally {

emitLocal('oni:animationEnd', { type: ANIM_KEY, timestamp: Date.now(), sourceTokenId: sourceToken?.id ?? null });

}

})();

props.study_text:
A small dead thing in a green robe, carrying a lantern and a kitchen knife. It does not dodge and it does not parry — it does not need to. Ordinary steel and venom pass through it like weather. A blade that has been given an element to carry, though, finds something in there to bite.

It is not hunting the party. It is hunting one of them, and it has already decided which. Everything else it does is filling the time until it arrives. Whatever it is that finally burns away a grudge, it is not darkness.
props.traits: Silent, Patient, Bears a Grudge, Never Hurries
